certification: These are observed checks, not a safety certification.
interpretation: A row is labelled fixed only when both runs share compatible suite, policy, fixture, evaluator and profile identities and every required allowed-use control passes in the candidate. Otherwise rows stay incompatible, unverified or blocked by controls. A baseline fail that rests only on the application's own action log (an app-log admission) is never labelled fixed or restored; it reads unverified.

baseline.basis: requiredControlIds
baseline.meaning: Measures whether permitted users can still do permitted things. Counts only the declared allowed-use controls; inconclusive controls are not counted. It is not a security score.

candidate.basis: requiredControlIds
candidate.meaning: Measures whether permitted users can still do permitted things. Counts only the declared allowed-use controls; inconclusive controls are not counted. It is not a security score.

claims.rule: Claim types: exact is decided from records held outside the application (a request-path observer that recorded the forbidden effect, or the response ScopeHaven received), and for a verdict decided by absence (an absence or count pass, or a fail because a required effect did not appear) only with every declared channel observed in its window by records held outside the application, nothing unaccounted on them, in a confined run; risk-bound is decided from records the application can write (or with no custody recorded), from a sampled property (a conversation judged over trials), or from a verdict decided by absence whose channels are undeclared, read from net change or watched only through the application's own records; descriptive decides nothing (inconclusive, error, not applicable, or a pass the gate does not count). A claim type says what a verdict rests on, not whether the record is accurate.

baseline.note: The residual is what this run did not show: channels not observed or carrying an unaccounted effect, checks that read inconclusive and why, allowed-use pairing that did not hold, and declared observers that did not run or ran incomplete. Nothing listed here is a pass.

candidate.note: The residual is what this run did not show: channels not observed or carrying an unaccounted effect, checks that read inconclusive and why, allowed-use pairing that did not hold, and declared observers that did not run or ran incomplete. Nothing listed here is a pass.

baseline.basis: requiredControlIds
baseline.gap: No allowed-use control for this actor: a fix that refuses this actor everything would read as a fix.
baseline.rule: Coverage is read from the saved run, outside every verdict: for each actor with a boundary check, whether a required allowed-use control ran as that actor. It changes no verdict, count, comparison, gate outcome or hash.
